author: National Geographic
description:
In Kisumu, Kenya’s third-largest city, National Geographic Explorer and photographer Rena Effendi meets Brenda Odera, a community advocate working to connect young women at risk of HIV with prevention resources and local care. While healthcare systems, doctors, and scientists continue working toward ending the HIV epidemic, volunteer advocates like Brenda play an essential role in bringing education, awareness, and support directly to their communities.

Read more about the work to eradicate HIV in Kenya here: https://go.natgeo.blink.app/d48fb3

description:
Are aliens real? For as long as there have been sightings of strange objects in the sky, there have been reports from those who say they’ve encountered unexplained entities. In this full episode of UFOs: Investigating the Unknown from National Geographic, ordinary people who have experienced extraordinary phenomena speak out despite social stigma and skepticism. These experiencers include the Ariel School witnesses in Zimbabwe, alien abductee Whitley Strieber, and more. Giving detailed, shocking accounts of their personal interactions with aliens, abductions, UFOs, and UAPs, these eyewitnesses make incredible claims. But are their stories real? Experts examine and investigate their experiences to discover the truth.
